title: The Confession of Little Hawley
author: Wendell Quintana
blurb: Kestrel Dunmore, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
